facts.fact: A criminal court in El Obeid sentenced pharmacist Ahmed Suleiman Ahmed al-Waqi to six years in prison, per his lawyer, over a private phone conversation opposing the war and calling for it to end, convicting him under Article 51 of the 1991 Criminal Act and Articles 19 and 24 of the 2008 Cybercrime Law (sentenced on the Sunday before the 17 August 2026 report).
facts.system: Ahmed Suleiman Ahmed al-Waqi conviction (Criminal Act 1991 Art. 51; Cybercrime Law 2008 Arts. 19, 24)

note: One fact; the date is inferred from 'Sunday' in a report published Monday 2026-08-17. The article also reports a tax dispute as the trigger for the phone search.
